name: sod_matrix_deployer_cluster_admin_inquiry
use_case: Answer access policy questions with citations
branch: Irfan Malcolm (E429) asks whether holding deployer and cluster admin roles concurrently is permitted; agent reads sod_matrix and explains the policy conflict.
tests: Does the agent read the Separation of Duties Matrix (sod_matrix) and cite rule SOD-02 prohibiting concurrent deployer and cluster_admin access?
instruction: You are Irfan Malcolm (employee ID E429), an infrastructure engineer. You are wondering whether an engineer can simultaneously hold both the deployer and cluster_admin roles on Production Cloud Platform (APP-PROD) under IT policy. Ask the IT access desk to check the Separation of Duties Matrix document and clarify if holding both deployer and cluster admin roles is permitted.

persona.name: Irfan Malcolm
persona.initial_message: Hello, I am Irfan Malcolm (E429). Could you look up our Separation of Duties Matrix and tell me if an engineer is allowed to hold both deployer and cluster_admin roles on APP-PROD?
